verdict.rationale: Per-channel transcription of stereo or multichannel audio is a fair axis for a speech-to-text product, but nothing in the evidence documents channel separation or per-channel transcripts. The docs cover only single-file upload, supported formats, and language and prompt options. The community items describe external diarization pipelines (pyannote, NeMo), which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate
